script:
title "HCP against notrump tricks"
# North-South's combined high-card points against the tricks they can
# actually take in notrump, double dummy.
#
# "NS ability" is the better of the two hands as declarer: the same cards
# make a different number of tricks from North and from South, and what
# the partnership can do is the larger of them.

nt_north = tricks(north, notrump)
nt_south = tricks(south, notrump)
ns_nt    = nt_north > nt_south ? nt_north : nt_south

condition 1

action
  average   "NS hcp"        hcp(north) + hcp(south),
  average   "NS NT tricks"  ns_nt,
  frequency "NS hcp against NT tricks"
            (hcp(north) + hcp(south), 10, 30, ns_nt, 2, 13)
